verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail says an API exists and claims it lets you 'take full control of your workflow', alongside a Zapier integration. Nothing documents which UI actions it exposes, such as scan requests, forwarding, check deposit, shipping or automation rules. Probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404, so no endpoint list could be found to check parity. Missing for 10: published API reference or OpenAPI spec, evidence of endpoints for scanning/forwarding/check deposit/shipping/automation rules, any explicit statement or demonstration of UI parity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
